features.title: Campaigns, worlds and scenes have their own home
features.description: Create or continue a D&D campaign, a full tabletop world, or a reusable encounter. Each workspace shows recent files and opens its own folder.

features.title: See your saved work at a glance
features.description: The workshop lists recent campaigns, worlds and saved encounters, including scenes in your local encounter library. Browse the full list whenever you need it.

features.title: Optional AI settings stay in one place
features.description: Open provider and voice options from the settings cog. Campaign files and terrain remain on your computer; online AI is optional.
